strengths: Drives technical direction is now shown as owned work (problem discovery, feature and model choice, evaluation) rather than implied, which the JD asks for at this level
Re-ranking is shown in real work twice: a re-ranker over a live recommendation system's candidate set with engineered ranking features, and a PyTorch cross-encoder over dense retrieval
Company-fit project covers the JD's exact task list: two-tower candidate generation, LightGBM learning-to-rank, multi-objective guardrails, cold-start, offline NDCG
The JD's named production stack is in bullets rather than listed: Python, SQL, PySpark, PyTorch, LightGBM, Docker, Airflow, MLflow, AWS
gaps: A/B testing and online experimentation are a stated requirement but appear only in the skills list with no supporting bullet
No large-scale consumer ranking or personalisation experience; neither re-ranker served millions of users
The strongest recommender-system bullet sits in a 6-month Data Analyst role, which reads junior for a senior ranking position
Sequential and generative recommenders, which the JD asks candidates to explore, are absent
